headline: OpenAI has updated ChatGPT's voice mode with its GPT-Live-1.1 model, improving speech in several languages and adding two Korean voices.
score_reason: Confirmed product update by OpenAI; incremental, with a regional angle.
importance_line: Everyday ChatGPT voice users, including free users worldwide, get more natural speech and less repetitive pauses while the assistant searches, though the gains are described by OpenAI and not independently measured.
summary: Digital Today of South Korea reports that OpenAI said on Thursday it has updated ChatGPT's voice feature on its GPT-Live-1.1 voice model, which improves intonation and expression in several languages including Korean and adds two Korean voices, "Hanul" (male) and "Haetsal" (female). The assistant now varies its phrases while it searches instead of repeating "checking", and the rollout is reaching users worldwide, free users included, in stages.
notes: Another pool item (C01-06) covers GPT-Live-1.1 from the model side; this entry is the product and Korean-voice angle.
